name: a dollar figure rolls up to the real total
looks: A large dollar amount rolls up through a couple of intermediate values to its final number, with a one-line caption underneath naming what it totals and a small dim footnote qualifying the figure as an estimate.
build: The digits roll up under a vertical blur whose strength follows their speed, settling on power3.out; the caption and footnote fade in just as the digits land, the footnote at lower opacity and smaller size.
sound: A rising tone under the roll-up, a soft pop as the digits settle.
prompt: Roll a large dollar figure up to its final total, digits blurring with their own speed, landing with a one-line caption naming what it totals and a small, honest footnote marking it as an estimate rather than an audited figure.
